issues.description: Field 'rides' in class ExcellenceLand: the problem statement (task description) requires 'rides' to be a private List<Ride> (problem_statement.md line 58), but the solution implementation declares it as a public field (solution_repository/src/de/tum/in/ase/ExcellenceLand.java line 9: 'public List<Ride> rides;'). This visibility mismatch contradicts the UML/task specification and may confuse students about the intended encapsulation and expected field visibility when implementing the class, its constructor, and getter.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the 'rides' attribute in ExcellenceLand to private (private List<Ride> rides;) in the solution (and template/example) and keep the public getter getRides() to provide access. Update the solution file (src/de/tum/in/ase/ExcellenceLand.java) so its field visibility matches the problem statement/UML, preserving encapsulation and aligning the reference implementation with the exercise specification.
